content.text:
Plugins are still supported in v4, but these docs don't have a guide to writing them (the v3 plugin-authoring page has no v4 equivalent).

- **Loading plugins:** `@plugin "@tailwindcss/typography";` loads a legacy JavaScript plugin. It accepts a package name or a local path. It can be combined with `@theme`, `@utility` and other CSS-driven features. (`src/docs/functions-and-directives.mdx`, "Compatibility" → `@plugin`, lines 276–322)
- **Status:** the docs list `@plugin` and `@config` under "Compatibility", meaning they exist for v3 compatibility. I found no v4 guide covering the plugin API (`addUtilities`, `matchUtilities` and so on). The searches only turned up older blog posts (v1.5, v1.7).
- **CSS-first alternative:** the section also says custom utilities and variants can now be defined in CSS, so many things that needed a plugin in v3 may not need one.

I'm not certain the docs never mention this, because the index searches may have missed it.
